detail.longDescription: NVIDIA PAIR turns idle computers on a local network into a personal AI cluster, distributing inference across devices for parallel agentic workflows. This points towards hybrid architectures that keep sensitive tasks local and escalate only demanding work to the cloud. But local processing alone is not sovereignty when hardware and optimisation remain tied to one vendor. https:// blogs.nvidia.com/blog/local-ai -ifa-next-gen-agents-nv-pair-rtx-spark/ # LocalAI # AgenticAI # DigitalSovereignty
